tickets.name: 01_damaged_auto_approve

ticket.body: Hi, two of the mugs in my order arrived cracked. Can I get a refund please?

ticket.subject: Return headphones
ticket.body: I changed my mind about the headphones, I'd like a refund.

tickets.description: Change of mind on a final-sale (clearance) item

ticket.subject: Return jacket
ticket.body: I don't like the colour of the jacket, I want to return it and get a refund.

tickets.name: 06_partial_final_sale_with_pii

ticket.subject: Towels damaged
ticket.body: The towels were damaged, I want a refund.

ticket.body: My plates arrived late, almost a week after the promised date. Can I get a refund of the shipping?
